verdict.rationale: The evidence includes a generic 'Forms & Official Fees' page, an Electronic Register of Patent Agents, and facilitator lists. None of it documents an authorization-of-agent form, the scope of what an agent may or may not do, or which signatures must remain personal to the applicant. These are adjacent listings, not a published delegation policy, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
